audit.whatIsWrong: Remove Scurvy is described only as a slow-cleanse/'escape button'. It is a heal on a 22/20/18/16/14s cooldown, and nothing in the matchup mentions Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health.' It has no movement component, so calling it an escape is wrong; the heal is what undoes your won trades, which makes anti-heal timing the decisive item choice.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] now buys Grievous Wounds against the 14-22s heal; wants.you[0] no longer calls W an escape.
